formula: I(qlogis(pmin(Confidence, 99.9) / 100) * (2 * (Response == Stimulus) - 1)) ~ scale(DotProportion) * scale(DotNumber) + (1 + scale(DotProportion) * scale(DotNumber) || Subj_idx)

notes: Readme (osf.io/download/4rhxa); Kvam and Pleskac 2016 Cognition 152; the analyses it links (OSF ba5c7): "Models - JAGS code/ConfidenceModel.txt" fits y[i] ~ dt(drift[i], tau[i], 4), drift = d0 + d1*strength + d2*weight + d12*strength*weight with every coefficient per subject from its own group normal (uncorrelated), and log sigma = s0 plus subject slopes on strength, weight and their product (a location-scale model, the scale part not representable).
